get.description: Returns lightweight runtime configuration including whether AI analysis is enabled.
Returns the snapshot of all currently active H3 hexagonal cells with qualifying flood observations for immediate client hydration on startup.

get.description: Returns the most recent AI-analyzed flood and rain verdicts for cameras in the Hot Set along with analysis_enabled status. When APP_ENV is not dev, verdicts with source=mock are strictly omitted. Unverified cameras are omitted per honesty rules.

Server-Sent Events (SSE) stream delivering real-time Hot Set verdict updates and H3 hex cell aggregations. Emits 'camera_update' and 'hex_update' events with JSON payloads and periodic heartbeat comments (: heartbeat).
get.summary: Real-time camera verdict and hex cell SSE stream

get.description: Retrieve sorted list of distinct post-reform Phường structured pairs
Returns list of all known road keys with associated camera counts, sorted by camera density descending.

Returns the aggregated traffic status for a named road corridor identified by road_key, including worst severity, coverage percentage, oldest observation age, and per-camera verdicts. Enforces ADR-004 §D4 honesty rules.
Proxy and cache a real-time traffic camera snapshot from the upstream DOT portal (TTL ≥ 10 s). Also triggers HotSet Touch for automatic AI analysis.
Lists all active subscriptions for a given user chat ID on a channel.

post.description: Subscribes a user chat ID on a channel (e.g. Telegram) to flood alerts (scope: all, chokepoint, zone, or ward).

delete.description: Unsubscribes a user chat ID from a specific flood alert target.

get.description: Serves OpenStreetMap raster tiles (PNG) cached on local disk with 30-day immutable HTTP cache headers.
Returns the most recent AI-analyzed congestion verdict for cameras in the Hot Set along with analysis_enabled status. When APP_ENV is not dev, verdicts with source=mock are strictly omitted.
Returns cached traffic severity, saturation index, and PCU counts for the 50 Hot Set priority arterial cameras with sub-5ms latency.
get.summary: Get latest 50 Hot Set traffic status and Saturation Index
